SELECT min(fairness_ledgers.accounted_through) AS min_1 
FROM fairness_ledgers

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT * 
FROM jobs, retry_schedules 
WHERE jobs.job_id = retry_schedules.job_id AND retry_schedules.closed_at IS NULL AND retry_schedules.ready_at <= clock_timestamp() AND retry_schedules.retry_number = jobs.retry_count AND jobs.state = %(state_1)s::VARCHAR AND (jobs.desired_state = %(desired_state_1)s::VARCHAR AND jobs.recovery_intent IS NULL OR jobs.desired_state = %(desired_state_2)s::VARCHAR AND jobs.recovery_intent = %(recovery_intent_1)s::VARCHAR)) AS anon_1

SELECT queue_eligibility_events.event_id, queue_eligibility_events.tenant_id, queue_eligibility_events.occurred_at, queue_eligibility_events.old_state, queue_eligibility_events.new_state, queue_eligibility_events.last_job_id, queue_eligibility_events.last_processed_at, queue_eligibility_events.completed_at 
FROM queue_eligibility_events 
WHERE queue_eligibility_events.completed_at IS NULL AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT older_eligibility_event.event_id 
FROM queue_eligibility_events AS older_eligibility_event 
WHERE older_eligibility_event.tenant_id = queue_eligibility_events.tenant_id AND older_eligibility_event.event_id < queue_eligibility_events.event_id AND older_eligibility_event.completed_at IS NULL)) ORDER BY queue_eligibility_events.last_processed_at ASC NULLS FIRST, queue_eligibility_events.event_id 
 LIMIT %(param_1)s::INTEGER FOR UPDATE

SELECT jobs.job_id, jobs.tenant_id, jobs.submitter_user_id, jobs.state, jobs.desired_state, jobs.waiting_reason, jobs.recovery_intent, jobs.version, jobs.job_fence, jobs.event_sequence, jobs.checkpoint_sequence, jobs.retry_count, jobs.max_retries, jobs.retry_of_job_id, jobs.base_priority, jobs.ready_sequence, jobs.eligible_since, jobs.retry_ready_at, jobs.terminal_at, jobs.created_at, jobs.updated_at, job_specs.job_id AS job_id_1, job_specs.tenant_id AS tenant_id_1, job_specs.canonical_spec, job_specs.spec_checksum, job_specs.template_id, job_specs.template_version, job_specs.input_artifact_id, job_specs.model_artifact_id, job_specs.cpu_millis, job_specs.memory_bytes, job_specs.gpu_count, job_specs.runtime_limit_seconds, job_specs.checkpoint_interval_seconds, job_specs.created_at AS created_at_1 
FROM jobs JOIN job_specs ON jobs.job_id = job_specs.job_id 
WHERE jobs.tenant_id = %(tenant_id_2)s::UUID AND jobs.state = %(state_1)s::VARCHAR AND jobs.created_at <= %(created_at_2)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE ORDER BY jobs.job_id 
 LIMIT %(param_1)s::INTEGER FOR UPDATE OF jobs

FROM queue_eligibility_events

SELECT fairness_ledgers.tenant_id, fairness_ledgers.virtual_score, fairness_ledgers.accounted_through, fairness_ledgers.had_eligible_demand, fairness_ledgers.version, fairness_ledgers.updated_at, fairness_ledgers.eligibility_signature 
FROM fairness_ledgers

INSERT INTO fairness_ledgers (tenant_id, virtual_score, accounted_through, had_eligible_demand) SELECT tenant_policies.tenant_id, %(param_1)s::VARCHAR AS anon_1, %(param_2)s::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE AS anon_2, %(param_3)s AS anon_3 
FROM tenant_policies 
WHERE tenant_policies.is_current IS true ON CONFLICT (tenant_id) DO NOTHING

SELECT fairness_ledgers.tenant_id, fairness_ledgers.virtual_score, fairness_ledgers.accounted_through, fairness_ledgers.had_eligible_demand, fairness_ledgers.version, fairness_ledgers.updated_at, fairness_ledgers.eligibility_signature
